_doc: Fixed tag vocabulary. Each paper: exactly 1 primary_tag + up to 3 more tags, all from paper_tags. Each news item: exactly 1 category from news_categories. Do not invent tags; propose changes to the repo owner instead.

LLMs.desc: Language-model behavior, capabilities and analysis that is not better captured by a more specific tag

Multimodal.desc: Vision-language and other multi-modality understanding models (VLMs, omni models)

Architectures.desc: New model architectures and components: attention variants, SSMs, MoE design, tokenization

Efficiency.desc: Inference/training efficiency: quantization, distillation, sparsity, KV cache, long-context cost, serving systems

Reasoning.desc: Chain-of-thought, test-time compute, math/logic reasoning, planning

Agents.desc: Tool use, computer/web use, coding and software-engineering agents, multi-agent systems

Retrieval & Memory.desc: RAG, search, long-term memory, knowledge editing

Pre-training & Data.desc: Pre-training recipes, scaling laws, data curation, synthetic data, representation learning

Post-training.desc: SFT, RLHF/RLAIF, preference optimization, instruction tuning, reward models

Reinforcement Learning.desc: RL algorithms and theory, RL for LLMs (e.g. RLVR) when the RL method itself is the contribution

Optimization.desc: Optimizers, training dynamics, stability, learning-rate schedules

Generative Models.desc: Diffusion/flow/autoregressive generation of images, video, audio, speech, 3D

World Models.desc: Models that learn environment dynamics for prediction, planning or simulation

Robotics.desc: Robot learning, VLA models, manipulation, locomotion, navigation, autonomous driving

Computer Vision.desc: Perception: detection, segmentation, 3D reconstruction, video understanding

Safety & Alignment.desc: Alignment methods, deception, control, oversight, dangerous capabilities, honesty

Interpretability.desc: Mechanistic interpretability, probing, features/circuits, model internals

Security.desc: Jailbreaks, prompt injection, adversarial attacks, privacy, watermarking

Evaluation & Benchmarks.desc: New benchmarks, evaluation methodology, measurement of capabilities

Society & Policy.desc: Economic/social impact, governance, fairness, human-AI interaction studies

AI for Science & Health.desc: Biology, chemistry, materials, physics, climate, medicine, healthcare

AI for Math.desc: Theorem proving, formal math (Lean), mathematical discovery

Theory.desc: Learning theory, generalization, expressivity, theoretical analysis of deep learning

RSI.desc: Recursive self-improvement, automated AI research, self-improving agents/models

news_categories.Model Release: A new or updated model (frontier, open-weight, specialized)
news_categories.Product & Features: New product, feature or capability launch
news_categories.Business & Funding: Funding rounds, valuations, M&A, partnerships, revenue
news_categories.Earnings & Markets: Earnings reports, financial results, market moves
news_categories.Compute & Infrastructure: Chips, data centers, compute deals, energy
news_categories.Policy & Legal: Regulation, government action, lawsuits, court rulings
news_categories.Safety & Security: Safety incidents, security breaches, safety frameworks
news_categories.Research: Research results reported as news (e.g. a lab's major paper or demo)
news_categories.Open Source: Major open-source releases of models, tools or datasets
